Request boundary: retained parts and service references
|
|-- AgentSession (request-related retained parts)
|   |-- Agent
|   |   |-- prepareRequest [installed by AgentSession]
|   |   |   |-- -> SessionManager.buildSessionProjection(): canonical messages
|   |   |   `-- -> ModelRuntime.resolveModel(): branch-aware virtual routing
|   |   |       `-- Retained selection unchanged; physical request may differ
|   |   |-- SDK-installed callbacks [sdk.ts]
|   |   |   |-- transformContext -> current ExtensionRunner.emitContext()
|   |   |   |-- convertToLlm -> provider messages; optional image filtering
|   |   |   `-- streamFn -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple()
|   |   |       `-- Settings + provider hooks -> request options/observations
|   |   |-- beforeToolCall / afterToolCall [installed by AgentSession]
|   |   |   `-- -> ExtensionRunner tool interception; not wrapper-owned
|   |   `-- state.tools -> executable loadout from session tool registry
|   |-- ExtensionRunner [_buildRuntime() creates and binds]
|   |   |-- <- ResourceLoader supplies extensions and shared runtime
|   |   `-- -> Registered definitions + execution contexts for tool wrappers
|   |-- Tool machinery [_refreshToolRegistry()]
|   |   |-- Definition maps + callable registry + loadout policy
|   |   `-- Transcript declarations != executable Agent context.tools
|   `-- Service references -> settingsManager / resourceLoader / modelRuntime
|
`-- AgentSessionServices (separate infrastructure bundle)
    `-- ModelRuntime [model-runtime.ts; also referenced by SDK callbacks]
        |-- pi-ai Models: provider registry and model storage
        |-- RuntimeCredentials -> supplied credentials or default AuthStorage
        `-- resolveModel()/streamSimple() -> routed, authenticated requests
